newsitem.title: USA: News sees about 200 HarperCollins layoffs.
newsitem.headline: News sees about 200 HarperCollins layoffs.

text.p: News Corp said Monday it expects to lay off nearly 200 more persons in restructuring its HarperCollins publishing unit worldwide.
About 40 U.S. jobs will be affected in all areas of the company.
In all, there will be 420 fewer positions, a spokesman said, with about 220 jobs already having been eliminated.
News Corp said earlier it would take a 1997 charge of US$270 million related to the restructuring.

It said it has no plans to sell HarperCollins, although it has acknowledged that publishing was a "difficult industry," in part because of the financial burden from booksellers being able to return unsold books.
A HarperCollins sale has been rumored in publishing circles.
